newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends weaker against dlr, mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends weaker against dlr, mark.

text.p: 1550 GMT - The Swiss franc ended weaker against the dollar and mark, with traders seeing mainly range-trade with some upward bias possible for the dollar.

Aurel David at Bank Julius Baer doubted the dollar would get as far on the downside as 1.6940 marks. He expected dollar/Swiss to drift higher, citing 1.4550 as a key level on the downside. "I would buy the dips, still," David said.
*The dollar ended at 1.4624/4634 Swiss francs versus 1.4650/4660 at the open, and 1.4560/4570 at Thursday's close.
* The mark ended at 85.94/95 Swiss centimes, up from 85.70/72 at Thursday's close, and 85.87/89 at Friday's open.
